text:
maria: Quick sync — we need a tight set of field-ready collateral for the enterprise launch next quarter. Goal: one compact deliverable bundle (one-pager + 2 supporting half-pages) covering security controls, SLA tiers, deployment modes (hosted/dedicated/private), and a 3–4 line benchmark narrative to lead with on the site. Target: draft by Mon EOD. Can we break this down?

aj: I can own the SLA and pricing blurb. For the benchmark narrative, suggest a 2-line headline + 2 metrics (p50 latency, cost/token delta vs baseline). Draft example: "Predictable sub-50ms p50 on short-chat workloads; 3x cost improvement via batching & prefix cache vs naive single-request serving." Is that too product-y? :thinking_face:

sam: That headline works. For the benchmark body we should call out workload shape and test harness (concurrency, avg tokens). Short example to include: 
```
Workload: 100 concurrent chat users, avg 32 tokens per request
Harness: run for 60m with steady-state warm caches
Baseline: open model vX on single-GPU
Result: p50 48ms, token cost -68%
```
Keep it short, but we need a link to the full benchmark appendix in our doc.

liz: I'll draft the security one-pager (focus: KMS/HSM integrations, VPC peering, audit logs, SOC2 posture). Can we standardize the top CTA text for security folks? Something like: "Enterprise security controls — private by default, auditable by design." Thoughts? :thumbsup:

noah: I'll add a small solutions-engineer section: quick decision matrix for deployment mode (best for startups vs regulated ent vs high-throughput real-time). One row per tradeoff (latency, cost predictability, data residency). Short and scannable.

maria: Great. Also need inbound lead routing rules for the sales team so they don't miss high-intent demos. Proposed quick rule snippet for the site contact form: 
```
if (company_size >= 1000 || security_checkbox == true || requested_sla == "enterprise") { route_to = "enterprise-sales"; priority = "high"; } else { route_to = "self-serve"; priority = "normal"; }
```
We should include this example in the one-pager appendix so field teams can copy/paste.

aj: I'll map that into Salesforce routing and add recommended qualification language for SDRs. Also propose an inbound tag: `enterprise-slas` and `private-deploy` so we can report conversions.

sam: Webinar plan quick note: 30–40 min, target: platform/infra leads + security. Outline: 1) real customer latency/cost story 2) demo of Dedicated + Private deploy 3) Q&A. Need a speaker list and one slide per deployment mode. I can draft slides.

liz: Timing: align the one-pager publish with the webinar invite (2 weeks before). Marketing ops, make sure the landing page has UTM tags and the contact form uses the routing snippet above.

gtm-bot: Reminder: existing collateral library -> https://redwoodhq.notion/link/enterprise-collateral-template (use template #ENT-ONEPAGER-2025).

maria: Action items:
- aj: SLA + routing -> draft by Fri noon
- liz: security one-pager -> draft by Fri EOD
- noah: deployment decision matrix + appendix -> Fri EOD
- sam: benchmark narrative + webinar outline -> Wed COB
- i'll assemble bundle and link to benchmark appendix, publish draft Monday.

Anything missing? If not, I'll create a shared folder and assign ownership there. :raised_hands:
